snippet.title: The Land Forgotten trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
A hand-painted adventure puzzle game where language is magic. Explore a mysterious land, decipher ancient scripts, and solve language-based puzzles to uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

Check out this exclusive trailer for The Land Forgotten by Daria!

The Land Forgotten in the Thinky Games DB: https://thinkygames.com/games/the-land-forgotten/
The Land Forgotten on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4481040/The_Land_Forgotten/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
